**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear Miss [name erased]
I am so sorry, but I am going to London on Monday for the [G F S](../others.html#23) affairs, and I do not come home till Saturday.

If you are going out on an expedition could you not take me on your way back? I come home on the 27th, and on any day but the 29th shall be at home.

At least I have promised to take [my niece](../persons.html#1613) in one day of the Assize week to see [Lord Coleridge](../persons.html#343) in court, and I am not quite sure which that will be

Yours sincerely

CM Yonge
